blocks.content: So far, you've only used solid colors in your designs.
However, CSS also provides two functions to create gradients—linear-gradient() and radial-gradient()—which allow you to blend multiple colors smoothly.
Let's explore these functions and see how to use them to add visual interest to your designs.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
